TPO is the three-letter code for phosphothreonine. The atoms include P (phosphorus), O1P, O2P, O3P which are characteristic of a phosphate group attached to the threonine.

TPO is phosphothreonine (threonine with phosphate attached to OG1). The residue identifier would be A:T12.

The format requested is chain:one-letter code + author residue number. TPO is phosphothreonine, so the one-letter code is T (threonine). The residue number is 12, chain A.
